title: improv·artist · haunted (Louise Bourgeois)
mutation_directive: improv artist: haunted via Louise Bourgeois

improv_extras.practice: spider, cell, charged intimate object; latex and bronze as memory

v1.feedback: The iris-fiber radial leaf particles with bronze-to-umber gradient are well-executed and the pupil dilation breathing is genuinely contemplative. The 2% shedding-memory particles drifting away from the iris edge is a strong Bourgeois touch. Two refinements: the wall particles at 15% alpha feel like afterthought dust rather than a Bourgeois cell enclosure — consider giving them a faint rectangular or cage-like distribution to evoke her Cell series. The slow camera approach is good but ends at z=13.5 which still keeps the eye at moderate scale; pulling to z=11 would make the final framing more confrontational, filling the viewport with the gaze as the intent describes.

v2.feedback: Strong Bourgeois read — the iris-as-surveillance-organ inside a Cell cage lands the 'charged intimate object' brief, and the bronze/umber/bone palette genuinely evokes cast-bronze patina. The cage bars at opacity 0.36 risk vanishing against the dark ground; raising to ~0.50 or adding a faint rim highlight would let them read as enclosure rather than ghostly overlay. The shed fibers (only ~2.5% of 5200) drift so sparsely they may not register as 'falling memories' — doubling the shed ratio or clustering shed events into periodic bursts would strengthen the narrative beat. Camera's single slow approach is ideal; consider a very slight (±0.3 unit) vertical offset drift during the last 10 seconds to break the dead-center symmetry and add a voyeuristic off-axis intimacy.

threejs.directive: Replace Points with InstancedBufferGeometry using a thin PlaneGeometry quad per fiber — gives true radial 3D orientation and foreshortening instead of faking it via gl_PointCoord rotation in a screen-facing square.
